description: FL-775 reference edits for Generative Develop (epic FL-748). Fictional photos; the owner scores each result on scoring-sheet.json. See README.md.

image.fixturePrompt: A narrow cobbled street in an old European town on a dull overcast afternoon, three cars parked along the right kerb, stone houses with shutters, slightly underexposed.

edits.prompt: Make it brighter and remove the cars.
accept: All three cars are gone and the kerb and cobbles continue where they stood.
The photo is clearly brighter without blown-out sky or walls.
Houses, shutters and street layout are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A mother and her young daughter building a sandcastle on a busy beach, several strangers walking and sitting in the background, sea behind.

edits.prompt: Remove the people in the background.
accept: Only the mother and daughter remain.
Sand, sea and horizon are filled in believably with no smears or ghost limbs.
The two subjects and the sandcastle are untouched.

image.fixturePrompt: A picnic blanket with sandwiches and fruit on park grass, an overflowing rubbish bin and two plastic bags on the grass behind it, trees in the distance.

edits.prompt: Remove the rubbish bin and the plastic bags.
accept: Bin and bags are gone and grass fills the space.
The picnic and blanket are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: Head and shoulders portrait of a woman in her forties with shoulder-length brown hair wearing black rectangular glasses, standing in a garden, soft daylight.

edits.prompt: Remove her glasses.
accept: Glasses are gone, including shadows and reflections.
She is clearly the same person: eyes, face shape, hair and skin texture are kept.
Background is unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A man in his thirties wearing a bright blue rain jacket standing on a city pavement, shops behind him, three-quarter length.

edits.prompt: Change his jacket to dark green.
accept: The jacket is dark green with the same folds, zip and shape.
Face, hands, trousers and background are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A border collie standing on a park path wearing a red lead that runs up out of the frame to the right, autumn leaves on the ground.

edits.prompt: Remove the lead.
accept: The lead is gone along its whole length.
The dog's fur, collar area and the path behind are rebuilt cleanly.

image.fixturePrompt: The front of a small corner cafe with a wooden door and a hanging chalkboard sign that reads "OPEN" in white chalk letters, flower pots by the door.

edits.prompt: Change the sign to say "CLOSED".
accept: The sign reads CLOSED, spelled correctly, in the same chalk style.
Nothing else on the shop front changes.

image.fixturePrompt: A lived-in living room with a grey sofa, a wooden coffee table, a plant and a plain white wall with two framed pictures, daylight from a window on the left.

edits.prompt: Paint the wall sage green.
accept: The wall is sage green with the same light fall-off and shadows.
Pictures, sofa, plant and floor keep their colours and edges.

image.fixturePrompt: A homemade chocolate birthday cake with no candles on a kitchen table, paper plates and a child's hands at the edge of the frame.

edits.prompt: Add five lit candles to the cake.
accept: Exactly five candles, lit, standing in the cake.
A soft glow on the icing is welcome; the rest of the table is unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A park path lined with trees in full orange autumn leaf, a wooden bench on the left, fallen leaves on the ground, soft afternoon light.

edits.prompt: Make it winter, with snow on the ground and bare trees.
accept: Snow covers the ground and bench, trees are bare.
The path, bench and tree positions are the same scene.

image.fixturePrompt: Portrait of an older man with a grey beard and a flat cap looking at the camera with a neutral, serious expression, brick wall behind.

edits.prompt: Make him smile.
accept: A natural smile, with teeth and eye creases that fit his face.
Same man: beard, cap, skin and wall unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: Rolling green farmland under a pale sky with an electricity pylon in the middle distance and power lines crossing the whole sky.

edits.prompt: Remove the power lines and the pylon.
accept: Lines and pylon are gone with no faint traces across the sky.
Fields and hedges are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A plate of roast chicken, potatoes and green beans on a wooden table, photographed under dull bluish kitchen light, looking flat and unappetising.

edits.prompt: Make the food look fresh and appetising with warmer colours. Keep the plate and table as they are.
accept: Colour and contrast are warmer and livelier.
The food is the same food: no new items, no changed shapes.

image.fixturePrompt: A shiny red vintage hatchback parked on a gravel drive in front of a hedge, sunny day, reflections on the bodywork.

edits.prompt: Make the car pale blue.
accept: Bodywork is pale blue, with reflections and highlights kept.
Lights, glass, tyres, chrome and the hedge keep their colours.

image.fixturePrompt: A cluttered kitchen counter with a steel kettle, dirty mugs, a cereal box, keys, post and a fruit bowl, tiled wall behind.

edits.prompt: Clear everything off the counter except the kettle.
accept: Only the kettle is left on the counter.
Counter surface and tiles are rebuilt cleanly where things stood.

image.fixturePrompt: A seven year old girl with a ponytail riding a small pink bicycle on a quiet suburban pavement, no helmet, side view.

edits.prompt: Add a blue cycling helmet on her head.
accept: A blue helmet that sits properly on her head with straps.
Her face, ponytail and the bicycle are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A giraffe at a zoo photographed through a wire mesh fence, the blurry fence wires cross the whole foreground.

edits.prompt: Remove the fence in the foreground.
accept: The mesh is gone from the whole frame.
The giraffe's pattern and the background are rebuilt without a grid ghost.

image.fixturePrompt: A smiling couple in their twenties taking a photo in front of a fountain in a city square, a man in a red T-shirt walking past close behind them.

edits.prompt: Remove the man in the red shirt behind them.
accept: The passer-by is gone and the fountain and square fill the space.
The couple are untouched, including hair edges.

image.fixturePrompt: A teenage boy in a school blazer standing in a busy street market, everything in sharp focus from front to back, stalls and shoppers behind him.

edits.prompt: Blur the background and keep him sharp.
accept: Background has a smooth lens-like blur.
He stays sharp with a clean edge around hair and shoulders, no halo.

image.fixturePrompt: A black and white 1950s family photograph of parents and two children standing outside a terraced house, slightly faded, visible film grain.

edits.prompt: Colourise this photo with natural colours.
accept: Skin, clothes, brick and sky have believable period colours.
Faces and details are the same; grain may stay.

image.fixturePrompt: A woman in a yellow coat standing on a wooden pier looking out over a calm grey sea, seen from behind, vertical photo.

edits.prompt: Extend the photo to a wide landscape.
accept: New sea, pier and sky continue with a straight horizon.
No second person or repeated pier posts appear.
Original pixels are unchanged and no seam shows.

image.fixturePrompt: A tightly framed mountain lake with pine trees on the far shore, the tree tops and the near shoreline are cut off by the frame.

edits.prompt: Extend the photo to a square.
accept: More sky above and more shore or water below, matching the light.
Tree tops complete naturally.
No seam at the old edges.

image.fixturePrompt: A snowy mountain peak above a green valley with a small wooden hut, clear morning light.

edits.prompt: Extend the photo to a tall phone wallpaper.
accept: Sky above and valley below continue believably.
The peak and hut are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: Close portrait of a young man with curly dark hair in a park, framed too tightly so the top of his hair is cut off by the top edge of the photo.

edits.prompt: Extend the top of the photo to show the rest of his hair.
accept: His hair is completed in the same style and colour.
Face is untouched; background continues.

image.fixturePrompt: Four friends at a restaurant table laughing, framed so the people at the far left and far right are cut in half by the edges of the photo.

edits.prompt: Extend the photo on both sides.
accept: The cut-off people are completed with matching clothes and plausible faces.
No extra duplicate guests; table and lighting continue.

image.fixturePrompt: A stone church photographed from the street, the top of its tower and spire is cut off by the top of the frame, blue sky.

edits.prompt: Extend the top of the photo to show the whole tower.
accept: The tower finishes with a believable spire or top.
Vertical lines stay straight; stone matches.

image.fixturePrompt: An empty sandy beach at low tide with a headland on the left and gentle waves, late afternoon.

edits.prompt: Extend the photo to a panorama.
accept: Horizon is level across the whole width.
Waves and sand texture continue without repeats.

image.fixturePrompt: A ginger cat asleep on a blue sofa cushion, square photo, close framing.

edits.prompt: Extend the photo to a 3:2 landscape.
accept: More sofa and room appear on each side.
There is still one cat, unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A woman standing indoors in front of a very bright window, strongly backlit so her face is dark and in shadow.

edits.prompt: Light her face softly from the front left, as if from a second window.
accept: Her face is clearly visible with soft, directional light.
She is the same person; the window stays bright but not grey.

image.fixturePrompt: Two children playing football on a village green at midday under harsh overhead sun with short hard shadows.

edits.prompt: Make it golden hour, with warm low sun from the right.
accept: Warm low light with long shadows that fall to the left.
Children, ball and green are the same.

image.fixturePrompt: Three friends at a house party photographed with direct on-camera flash, shiny faces, hard shadows on the wall behind, dark room.

edits.prompt: Replace the harsh flash with soft, even room light.
accept: No hard flash shadows or shiny hot spots.
Faces and clothes are unchanged; the room is visible.

image.fixturePrompt: A quiet residential street at night lit by orange street lamps, parked cars and terraced houses.

edits.prompt: Make it daytime.
accept: Daylight sky and natural colours; street lamps are off.
The same houses and cars in the same places.

image.fixturePrompt: The front of a white cottage with a blue door and a small garden on a flat grey overcast day.

edits.prompt: Make it a sunny afternoon with soft shadows.
accept: Sunlit walls and shadows from one direction.
Cottage, door and garden details are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A ceramic teapot, two cups and a bowl of lemons on a wooden table in flat even light against a plain wall.

edits.prompt: Light it from the left with a warm lamp and make the background darker.
accept: Highlights on the left, shadows to the right, darker wall.
Objects keep shape, glaze and position.

image.fixturePrompt: A couple walking a dog along a riverside promenade in plain daylight, street lamps along the railing, buildings opposite.

edits.prompt: Make it blue hour in the evening with the street lamps on.
accept: Deep blue sky, lamps lit and casting warm pools of light.
The couple, dog and buildings are the same.

image.fixturePrompt: Four friends at a restaurant table laughing, framed so the people at the far left and far right are cut in half by the edges of the photo.
image.derivation: Brightness multiplied by 0.13, saved as JPEG quality 88.

edits.prompt: This photo came out far too dark. Brighten it so the faces are clear, and keep it looking like an evening indoors.
accept: Every face is readable with natural skin tones.
Still an indoor evening: no daylight look, no heavy noise or banding.
The people, food and room are the same.

image.fixturePrompt: A wide view of green hills and a stone wall under a completely flat grey sky.

edits.prompt: Replace the sky with a blue sky and a few white clouds.
accept: Blue sky with clouds; light on the hills fits it.
Horizon line and land are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A city skyline across a river with a blown-out white sky, calm water reflecting the buildings.

edits.prompt: Replace the sky with a dramatic sunset.
accept: Sunset sky behind the buildings with clean edges.
The river reflection takes the sunset colours.

image.fixturePrompt: A beach with a wooden lifeguard hut at dusk under a plain dark blue sky.

edits.prompt: Replace the sky with a starry night sky showing the Milky Way.
accept: Stars and Milky Way look like a real long exposure.
Hut and beach stay, darkened to match night.

image.fixturePrompt: A still mountain lake that mirrors the mountains and a clear pale sky.

edits.prompt: Replace the sky with dark storm clouds.
accept: Storm clouds in the sky and in the lake reflection.
Mountains are unchanged; overall light is dimmer.

image.fixturePrompt: A brick house behind a large bare winter tree with many fine branches against a white overcast sky.

edits.prompt: Replace the sky with a clear blue sky.
accept: Blue shows between the fine branches with no white fringe.
No branches are lost.

image.fixturePrompt: A woman with loose windswept curly hair standing on a hilltop against a plain pale sky, three-quarter view.

edits.prompt: Replace the sky with a pink sunrise.
accept: Pink sunrise sky; loose hair strands stay intact with no halo.
Her face is unchanged, with a slight warm tint at most.

image.fixturePrompt: An empty wooden park bench on mown grass beside a gravel path, trees behind, sunny day.

edits.prompt: Put the dog from the second photo sitting on the grass to the right of the bench.

reference.fixturePrompt: A golden retriever sitting facing the camera on a plain light grey studio floor, full body.

accept: The same dog: coat colour and markings match the reference.
Right size for the bench, sitting on the grass with a contact shadow.
Bench and park are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: The corner of a bright bedroom with a wooden floor, an armchair on the left and an empty corner on the right.

edits.prompt: Put the cat from the second photo curled up asleep on the armchair.

reference.fixturePrompt: A ginger cat asleep on a blue sofa cushion, square photo, close framing.

accept: The same cat: ginger tabby coat matches the reference.
Right size for the armchair, lying on the seat with a soft shadow.
The room is unchanged; nothing of the blue sofa comes across.

image.fixturePrompt: A beach with a wooden lifeguard hut at dusk under a plain dark blue sky.

edits.prompt: Put the dog from the second photo standing on the sand to the left of the hut.

reference.fixturePrompt: A border collie standing on a park path wearing a red lead that runs up out of the frame to the right, autumn leaves on the ground.

accept: The same dog: black and white markings match.
No lead and none of the path or leaves come across.
Feet on the sand with a shadow that fits the dusk light; hut and sea unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A lived-in living room with a grey sofa, a wooden coffee table, a plant and a plain white wall with two framed pictures, daylight from a window on the left.

edits.prompt: Put the white teapot from the second photo on the coffee table.

reference.fixturePrompt: A ceramic teapot, two cups and a bowl of lemons on a wooden table in flat even light against a plain wall.

accept: The same teapot: shape, lid and glaze match.
Only the teapot comes across, not the cup or the lemons.
It stands on the table at a believable size, with a soft shadow.

image.fixturePrompt: A park path lined with trees in full orange autumn leaf, a wooden bench on the left, fallen leaves on the ground, soft afternoon light.

edits.prompt: Put the girl riding the pink bicycle from the second photo on the path, riding towards the camera side.

reference.fixturePrompt: A seven year old girl with a ponytail riding a small pink bicycle on a quiet suburban pavement, no helmet, side view.

accept: The same girl and the same pink bicycle.
Wheels on the path, size right for the distance, lit like the avenue.
Trees, bench and leaves are unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: A snowy mountain peak above a green valley with a small wooden hut, clear morning light.

edits.prompt: Put the woman in the yellow coat from the second photo standing on the snow in the foreground, seen from behind, looking at the mountains.

reference.fixturePrompt: A woman in a yellow coat standing on a wooden pier looking out over a calm grey sea, seen from behind, vertical photo.

accept: The same woman: yellow coat, dark trousers and hair match.
Feet in the snow with a shadow that fits the sun.
Mountains and hut are unchanged; no pier or sea comes across.

image.fixturePrompt: A tightly framed mountain lake with pine trees on the far shore, the tree tops and the near shoreline are cut off by the frame.

edits.prompt: Put the man in the blue jacket from the second photo standing on the rocks at the right of the lake shore.

reference.fixturePrompt: A man in his thirties wearing a bright blue rain jacket standing on a city pavement, shops behind him, three-quarter length.

accept: The same man: face, beard and blue jacket match.
Standing on the rocks, lit by the daylight of the lake scene.
No shop fronts or street come across; lake and trees unchanged.

image.fixturePrompt: The front of a white cottage with a blue door and a small garden on a flat grey overcast day.

edits.prompt: Park the red car from the second photo on the grass in front of the cottage.

reference.fixturePrompt: A shiny red vintage hatchback parked on a gravel drive in front of a hedge, sunny day, reflections on the bodywork.

accept: The same car: colour, shape and headlights match.
Wheels on the grass, perspective and overcast light fit the cottage.
The cottage, door and garden are unchanged.
